run_CDP_command: run a raw Chrome DevTools Protocol command via browser_cdp with method and params
list_browser_tabs: list open browser tabs using browser_cdp with method='Target.getTargets'
handle_js_dialog: handle a native JavaScript dialog using browser_cdp with Page.handleJavaScriptDialog
evaluate_js_in_tab: evaluate JavaScript expression in a specific browser tab using browser_cdp with Runtime.evaluate
get_browser_cookies: get all cookies from the browser using browser_cdp with Network.getAllCookies
